examples.label: Example 1
examples.display:
logs    = [[1, 4, 9], [2, 4]]
offsets = [0, 0]
limit   = 5
output  = [0, 1, 0, 1, 0]

Both servers have an entry at time 4; server 0 goes first.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
logs    = [[10, 20], [0, 5]]
offsets = [0, 12]
limit   = 3
output  = [0, 1, 1]

Server 1 runs 12 behind, so its entries are really at 12 and 17. Only the first three are asked for.
